name: Hawaiian Humane Society Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens ages 15 to 17 help care for shelter animals and help the community. Some roles let a junior volunteer work alone. Some roles need a teen to volunteer with an adult.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 17. Check each role in the Opportunities Directory for its age rule. Teens who cannot give a weekly shift for three months go through the Youth and Education Department instead.
pay_detail: Unpaid. There is a $15 Junior Volunteer Application Fee.
duration: The page asks for a weekly shift for three months. Some roles need a teen to volunteer with an adult. Check each role for its time commitment.
deadline_text: No deadline. Allow about 6 weeks for the application and training. Applications are kept for 6 months.
how_to_apply: Pick a role in the Opportunities Directory. Finish the Junior Volunteer Application Process. It has a $15 Junior Volunteer Application Fee. Training has a 2 to 3 hour in person class and shadow shifts. You also take online courses that can take about 5 to 6 hours.
notes: The page does not state an application window or year. It says to check back and apply at a later time. Youth who want service hours can go through the Youth and Education Department.
